definitions: A system of government in which most of the important decisions are taken by state officials rather than by elected representatives.
A large group of people who are involved in running a country or a large organisation, and who have a lot of power.
Excessively complicated administrative procedure, especially one perceived as impeding effective action.
examples: The company is trying to reduce bureaucracy.
He spent years fighting red tape and bureaucracy.
The project was delayed by government bureaucracy.
